title: Supply Chain Attack on org.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind
technical_mechanism: multi-stage payload delivering platform-specific Cobalt Strike executables
summary: A malicious package 'org.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind' was discovered in the Maven ecosystem. The attack involved namespace-prefix-swap typosquat + trojan downloader. Mechanism: multi-stage payload delivering platform-specific Cobalt Strike executables
